item.title: SHAFT 0.80.0
item.description:
Added

  • Notes from Claude: `shaft mcp serve` is a local MCP server that Claude Desktop and Claude Code start; its `shaft_send` tool leaves a note (and up to 10 files) in an instance's inbox, read at its next wake. Opt-in per instance (`shaft claude-notes <name> on`, the web Access page, the apps' instance settings); secrets are scrubbed. (#62)
  • The apps log every main-thread stall of 100 ms or more (subsystem SHAFT, category Hitches), naming the transition under way. (#61)

Changed

  • The apps' chat screen builds only the messages on screen: a chat switch held the main thread 650–690 ms with 80 long turns, now about 160 ms; scrolling a long chat went from 28–34 to 62–75 fps; a streaming reply no longer stalls the app (Mac; the feed is shared with iPhone and iPad). (#61)
  • Meeting transcripts: online recordings are mixed and transcribed in chunks of up to 28 s with the previous text, the speakers' names and `SHAFT_LISTEN_VOCABULARY` as context; words go to speakers by diarisation and channel loudness. Fewer invented outros, lost greetings and misheard terms. (#63)

Fixed

  • A Mac dev run (SHAFT_DEV_DIR) no longer reaches the operator's real meeting recordings folder. (#61)
